title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Long Outage Allowance on a Downtime Credit
content:
A breakdown that takes a large share of a Ridgeline Tool Rental rental earns added days on the downtime credit.

> A long outage adds days to the lost days: when three times the calendar days from the report date to the return date is at least the rental days of the downtime credit, half a day (0.5) is added; when it is less than that but five times those calendar days is at least the rental days of the downtime credit, a quarter day (0.25) is added; when five times those calendar days is less than the rental days of the downtime credit, none is added.

The added days are added to the lost days before the lost days are multiplied by the net daily rental cost.

**Quantities.** The outage is the calendar days from the date of the most recent malfunction report to the return date. The rental days of the downtime credit are the daily periods billed, plus 7 for each weekly period, 28 for each four-week period, half a day for each four-hour period and 2 for a weekend special. The parts named, 3 and 5, are multiples of the outage compared with the rental days.

## Outage table (hypothetical rental of 7 rental days)

| Outage, calendar days | Three times the outage | Five times the outage | Days added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 9, at least 7 | 15 | 0.5 |
| 2 | 6, less than 7 | 10, at least 7 | 0.25 |
| 1 | 3 | 5, less than 7 | 0 |

## Equality edge (hypothetical rental of 15 rental days)

An outage of 5 days gives three times 5, that is 15, exactly the rental days: half a day is added. An outage of 3 days gives 9 and 15: a quarter day is added.
